title: Supreme Court removes litigant from courtroom after he hurls abuses at judges, flings documents
description: A litigant had to be forcibly removed from the Supreme Court on Friday after he hurled abuses in court and flung documents during the hearing of his petition challenging a decision of the Allahabad High Court [Prabal Pratap vs. State of Uttar Pradesh].The development took place before a Bench of Justice KV Viswanathan and Justice Alok Aradhe.The courtroom atmosphere turned dramatic when the petitioner, one Prabal Pratap, who appeared in person, displayed an unusually aggressive stance in his sub
